scope: 47 real rendered initial app states at two window sizes; sixteen contact sheets were manually visually read. Public application state API initializes windows; this is not 94 native Launcher interaction proofs, a physical-device study, or all-state/all-feature acceptance.

rows.title: Recall
rows.observation: Method groups and limits are folded; two-column controls remain dense in compact view. Recording and background/OS-wide recall are not inferred from an idle preview.

rows.title: Files
rows.observation: Folder table and top actions are legible at both sizes; the operation journal is real test-generated state. Initial view is not an exercise of every file operation.

rows.title: Editor
rows.observation: Sparse, clear no-document state; Save is visible but no file is open. Empty state is not an editing/encoding acceptance test.

rows.title: Find
rows.observation: Primary controls fit in compact view; saved searches and diagnostics are folded. Initial results area is visually sparse. Functional acceptance is in the native search suite, not this image.

rows.title: Terminal
rows.observation: Minimal dark terminal and one-line context; the visible surface is the application VFS shell, not a claim to expose the host operating-system terminal.

rows.title: SSH
rows.observation: Connection/key controls fit; recent localhost address is the real disposable sshd used by the native suite. Password/host-key guidance is still a paragraph.

rows.title: Notes
rows.observation: Compact title input ellipsizes, tags and Save stay available, outline and extra commands are folded. Saved test notes are visible; a screenshot alone cannot establish ownership/CAS correctness.

rows.title: Browser
rows.observation: Blocked external embed is explicitly disclosed; handoff, proxy and reader paths are distinct. The failure explanation remains wordy; sandbox egress refusal is not evidence that all external sites refuse embedding.

rows.title: Media
rows.observation: Native empty player is honest; captions and export panels occupy substantial vertical space. Real external receiver/playback/codec behavior was not established by this view.

rows.title: Capture
rows.observation: Empty authorized-capture preview; browser and storage limits are visible. An initial Muted HUD overlays part of the view. No physical screen-sharing/audio grant was exercised here.

rows.title: Lens
rows.observation: Camera start and effect controls are visible, with a blank unstarted preview. Compact canvas/controls still fit; lower transport explanations are dense. Physical camera/microphone quality is unverified.

rows.title: Beam
rows.observation: Several real transport APIs are separated from explicitly blocked native protocols. Status and explanatory cards are text-heavy; availability is not evidence of a receiver connection.

rows.title: Together
rows.observation: Room/media controls and idle event panel are legible. Not joined; this image does not prove two-device clock synchronization.

rows.title: Messages
rows.observation: Bridge configuration and generic message connector are visible, followed by capability explanations. This remains an externally dependent/skeleton surface, not a verified universal messaging client.

rows.title: Vault
rows.observation: Focused create-vault card with no-recovery and encryption warning. A reported passkey capability does not prove a physical authenticator ceremony.

rows.title: Privacy
rows.observation: Creation and encrypted-restore forms fit. Security and persistence claims require separate tests; no claim of secure disk erasure or resistance to a compromised host is inferred.

rows.title: Backup
rows.observation: Export, saved bundles, recovery key and restore form are organized but still dense, especially compact. Critical secret/recovery warnings should not be removed merely to lower a word count.

rows.title: Alerts
rows.observation: Clear no-alert state and explicit browser notification boundary; cannot read another application’s notifications. Physical OS delivery/permission interaction is not proved by this capture.

rows.title: Monitor
rows.observation: Measured browser/runtime values are visibly labeled, not host-wide instrumentation. Long compositor/job detail creates a dense scrolling initial module; frame cost is only a thermal proxy.

rows.title: Apps
rows.observation: Install/handler declarations are explained as declarations, not installed-OS acceptance. Large handler/startup listing remains text-heavy; native handler registration needs installed-device verification.

rows.title: Calculator
rows.observation: Keypad and result/history controls are clear; converter is below the fold compact. Existing Number/programmer precision and breadth boundaries remain, despite the polished initial keypad.

rows.title: Settings
rows.observation: Original layout diagrams/style swatches help scanning. Numerous settings remain in one long scrolling pane; not a complete reduction of wordiness or exhaustive device/settings test.

rows.title: Spec
rows.observation: The full 627-row register is a deliberately long document, with filter/export/status tools. Rendered-text word count includes off-viewport register rows; it is not the number simultaneously visible.

rows.title: Clock
rows.observation: World clocks and timezone conversion are legible; stopwatch/timer/tool sections create a long document. Test browser timezone is not proof of all physical-device alarm/background behavior.

rows.title: Planner
rows.observation: Concise task toolbar, folded notes/limits and clear empty agenda. Foreground reminder notice is retained; background OS scheduling remains outside the verified contract.

rows.title: Devices
rows.observation: Capability tabs and unstarted recorder are clear. Zero origin-storage usage is compatible with a fresh browser context and is separate from server VFS size. No hardware was attached or invented.

rows.title: Share
rows.observation: Honest empty screen/room controls and browser-only transport boundary. No physical second device or authenticated remote hardware connection was exercised here.

rows.title: Routines
rows.observation: Workspace preset and original command-list routine editor are coherent; dry-run status is distinct from execution. Empty routine list is not proof of trigger coverage.

rows.title: Clipboard
rows.observation: Clear zero-entry memory-only state; explicit capture is required for another app’s clipboard. Scope explanation remains long but avoids falsely implying OS-wide clipboard surveillance.

rows.title: Storage
rows.observation: Server VFS values are populated (505/515 KiB across sequential captures), origin usage is separately zero, real generated duplicate groups are visible. Initial zero VFS is not reproduced here; duplicate actions need separate ownership tests.

rows.title: Archive
rows.observation: Clean no-archive state; many actions share a horizontally scrollable toolbar. No encryption/extraction acceptance is inferred from disabled controls.

rows.title: Local disk
rows.observation: One clear mount action and an honest direct-child/UTF-8/conflict boundary. A real OS directory permission grant and file-system-provider equivalence were not exercised here.

rows.title: Photos
rows.observation: Actual VFS thumbnails/graphics are visible and wrap in compact view. Both captures missed network-idle settling, explicitly retained rather than relabeled; initial thumbnails are not all format/metadata/recipe operations.

rows.title: Image Editor
rows.observation: Canvas, tool icons and layer/brush controls are readable in compact view; horizontal toolbar overflow is folded. An empty background layer is not all editing/format coverage.

rows.title: Vector
rows.observation: Original shapes on canvas, explicit tools and properties are visible at both sizes. Native resize/export checks supply actual dimensions; initial layout alone is not SVG equivalence.

rows.title: Writer
rows.observation: Toolbar overflow has a More action; document canvas scrolls in compact view. An authentic recovery offer from earlier interrupted test work is visible, not an invented clean-store screenshot. Cross-paragraph correctness comes from the independent saved ZIP/XML test.

rows.title: PDF
rows.observation: Clear no-file state, short toolbar and page/forms/signatures tabs. Empty viewer is not a PDF fidelity/security/signature acceptance test.

rows.title: Books
rows.observation: Small, clear open-book prompt with the scripts-never-run boundary retained. No claim that all EPUB variants were manually opened in this review.

rows.title: Slides
rows.observation: Initial editable slide/thumbnail and speaker-note area fit both sizes. Toolbar uses overflow; kept-media-not-played caveat is visible. No universal PPTX fidelity claim.

rows.title: Spreadsheet
rows.observation: Dense editable grid intentionally scrolls; measured body scrollWidth exceeds clientWidth by 289px wide/575px compact. Do not report zero overflow or that all columns/actions are visible at once; native layout tests separately exercise navigation/save/export.

rows.title: Contacts
rows.observation: Address-book empty state is clear. The compact toolbar clips later actions at the initial scroll position; CSS deliberately supplies horizontal toolbar scrolling, rather than wrapping. Discoverability is a follow-up, not proof that controls were removed.

rows.title: Tables
rows.observation: Initial linked task table is coherent and readable; wide data columns scroll within the data area. This view does not establish every type/link/formula operation.

rows.title: Whiteboard
rows.observation: Original sample sticky, ellipse and connector are legible; layer list remains beside the canvas compact. Sample content is disclosed, not a purported user-created drawing.

rows.title: Peek
rows.observation: Minimal Nothing to preview state; intentionally almost no prose. A selected-file preview would be a different state to verify.

rows.title: Video
rows.observation: Empty player, URL field and saved-library area are clear. External service playability is not established in an egress-restricted sandbox.

rows.title: Music
rows.observation: URL and library controls are clear, but the multi-service example explanation remains verbose. No streaming entitlement, physical audio, or external-service availability assertion.

rows.title: Maps
rows.observation: Real offline border map, original controls and attribution fit compact. No tile server/online route/physical GPS success is inferred; GeoNames and Natural Earth are attributed.

finalBuildSupplement.scope: Four real updated Notes/Find mark views plus compact Contacts after native browser scroll/click. Supplemental five views, not a second all-app initial review.
finalBuildSupplement.observation: New header marks are visible and consistent at both sizes. Notes compact controls wrap; Find stays sparse with folded details. Contacts Duplicates actually opens and is reachable by horizontal toolbar scrolling; later/earlier actions are not simultaneously visible, and discoverability remains a follow-up.
finalBuildSupplement.sourceStage: Historical source 4 icon/compact-layout review; AppIcon/Contacts were not changed by the later Browser/Spec/Beam repairs.

reviewRepairSupplement.manualReview: All ten before-spacing and all ten final screenshots were actually viewed using read_file; not replacements for the 94 source-3 initial app views.
